title: Urban GNSS, Multipath and NLOS
dek: Robust positioning in dense environments affected by signal blockage, multipath, and non-line-of-sight reception.
body: Buildings can block or reflect satellite signals, producing non-line-of-sight measurements and multipath errors that degrade positioning.
This work explores 3D mapping-aided GNSS, shadow matching, robust weighting, and factor graph optimization as methods for studying and improving urban navigation.
